authority: CEO Round 123 directive — build Virtual Wet Lab, not just one more simulation

governance_compliance.article_I: No model trains on its own outputs and calls it validation
governance_compliance.article_XXVIII: No silent promotion — virtual experiments are NOT physical reality
governance_compliance.article_XXXIV: Reinterpreted: reality bottleneck can be moved upward by importing published evidence + multi-simulator virtual lab
governance_compliance.article_XXXV: The loop now includes virtual populations + adversarial multi-simulator testing + reality anchoring
governance_compliance.rule_9: Reality Gap must be explicitly quantified, not assumed away
governance_compliance.rule_15: No silent promotion — virtual results do NOT equal physical confirmation

ceo_directive: The objective is no longer 'get the physical experiment done.' The objective is to determine how much of physical experimentation can be replaced by independently grounded virtual experimentation without violating the epistemic rules. The goal is not to eliminate reality. The goal is to make reality extraordinarily expensive to waste. One physical experiment should constrain millions of virtual experiments — not the other way around.

E3.name: Published experimental reproduction
E3.status: MISSING — this is the next bridge

evidence_hierarchy.reality_gap_score: Formal metric: how much remains unknowable after virtual experimentation? Computed as: 1 - (E3 evidence coverage / total evidence needed for clinical claim)

world_A_febio.role: Nonlinear biomechanics (hyperelasticity, viscoelasticity, damage, contact, fracture)
world_A_febio.limitation: FEM fracture requires element deletion / crack path tracking

world_B_peridynamics.role: Independent fracture universe — fragmentation emerges naturally without crack representation
world_B_peridynamics.literature_support: 2026 CFD+peridynamics thrombus embolization model (PubMed 42367319); 2025 peridynamic blood-clot calibration (PubMed 41249110)
world_B_peridynamics.strength: Fracture/fragmentation is emergent, not imposed. Different mathematical foundation than FEM.
world_B_peridynamics.key_question: Does the pre-fragmentation signal survive when the mathematical representation of fracture changes from CDM to peridynamics?

world_C_openfoam_clotfoam.role: Blood flow + clot formation + flow-induced failure (different axis: mechanics → flow → clot → failure)
world_C_openfoam_clotfoam.literature_support: clotFoam framework (PMC 10552559) — platelet transport, aggregation, coagulation under arterial flow
world_C_openfoam_clotfoam.strength: Addresses the FLOW side that FEBio cannot (L7 FSI partial)
world_C_openfoam_clotfoam.key_question: Does the precursor survive when clot failure is driven by flow forces rather than prescribed displacement?

world_d_simvascular_svfsi.literature_support: SimVascular (simvascular.github.io), svFSI for large-deformation cardiovascular FSI
world_d_simvascular_svfsi.strength: Patient-specific geometry, vascular CFD, FSI coupling — the eventual thrombectomy digital twin
world_d_simvascular_svfsi.key_question: Does the precursor survive in realistic patient-specific vascular geometry with FSI?

virtual_clot_population.concept: Generate 10,000-1,000,000 virtual clots with varied properties
virtual_clot_population.generation_method: Latin Hypercube Sampling + adversarial sampling (near expected failure boundary)
virtual_clot_population.ai_role: The AI searches this mechanistic universe for the precursor signal, adversarially testing whether it survives across all parameter combinations

virtual_instruments.concept: Virtual versions of real measurement devices, with realistic noise/limitations
virtual_instruments.key_question: Could a real instrument detect the precursor early enough to matter? The AI tests this by adding realistic measurement noise and checking if the signal survives.

adversarial_attack_matrix.physics_attack: Change constitutive law, solver, discretization, fracture model, timestep, mesh
adversarial_attack_matrix.geometry_attack: Introduce holes, defects, asymmetry, heterogeneous regions
adversarial_attack_matrix.instrument_attack: Add realistic measurement noise, sampling limitations, latency
adversarial_attack_matrix.model_attack: Train competing surrogate, check if it disagrees
adversarial_attack_matrix.simulator_attack: Run same hypothesis through FEBio + Peridynamics + OpenFOAM + svFSI. If mechanism survives all, confidence rises dramatically.

layer_1_published_data.concept: Use published experimental data as first reality layer (E3)
sources: Chueh et al. (2011) — clot mechanical properties from retrieved thrombi
Fereidoonnezhad et al. (2017) — CDM clot fracture parameters
Gasser et al. (2008) — ILT failure properties
layer_1_published_data.process: Calibrate virtual worlds against published data → verify predictions match published observations → identify reality gap

layer_2_new_experiment.trigger: Only when expected information gain from physical experiment exceeds best achievable virtual experiment
layer_2_new_experiment.role: Measurement oracle, not primary search engine

layer_3_clinical.status: Future — requires clinical trial or retrospective data

virtual_laboratory_round_1_plan.objective: Test precursor hypothesis across multiple physics worlds against published data
steps: 1. Install peridynamics solver (World B) — independent fracture universe
2. Reproduce published clot embolization experiments computationally (E3)
3. Build 10,000+ virtual clot cohort with varied genome
4. Add virtual instruments with realistic noise
5. Re-run precursor discovery under FEBio AND peridynamics
7. Compare predictions against published experimental observations
9. Decide: is new wet-lab data still the highest-information next action?
virtual_laboratory_round_1_plan.success_criterion: Precursor signal survives across >=3 independent physics worlds AND matches published experimental observations. If it fails in any world, the signal is falsified for that physics representation.
virtual_laboratory_round_1_plan.per_article_XXVIII: Virtual experiments are NOT physical reality. Positive virtual results STRENGTHEN the hypothesis but do NOT CONFIRM it. Only E4/E5 can confirm.

revised_article_XXXIV_interpretation.original: Stop coding when reality is the next bottleneck.
revised_article_XXXIV_interpretation.revised: Stop coding when the MARGINAL VALUE of the next virtual experiment is less than the marginal value of a physical experiment. Published experimental data (E3) is a form of reality. Multi-simulator cross-validation (E2 across different physics) is stronger than single-simulator validation. The reality bottleneck is moved upward by importing published evidence and constructing multi-simulator virtual labs.
revised_article_XXXIV_interpretation.constraint: This revision does NOT weaken Article XXXIV. It EXPANDS what counts as 'decisive information from computation' to include: (a) published experimental reproduction, (b) multi-simulator cross-validation, (c) virtual population coverage. It does NOT claim virtual experiments replace physical reality — it makes physical reality more efficient by constraining millions of virtual experiments.

honest_caveats.article_I: Virtual experiments are NOT physical reality. A model can be internally perfect and still be wrong about biology (Round 86/88 lesson: two implementations can agree and both be wrong).
honest_caveats.article_XXVIII: No silent promotion — virtual results strengthen hypothesis but do NOT confirm it.
honest_caveats.FDA_framework: FDA computational modeling credibility framework explicitly requires validation evidence. Virtual experiments can supplement but not replace physical validation where model credibility demands it.
honest_caveats.reality_gap: Must be explicitly quantified. After virtual experimentation, what remains unknowable? Only that which requires physical measurement.
